_comment: Keychain Studio landing (Phase 1 preview). Full builder arrives in Phase 4.
title: Keychain Studio
intro: Design a keychain that feels like yours — hardware, beads, letters, and charms, assembled into something small enough to carry everywhere.

blocks.html: The interactive builder is coming soon. For now, browse the shop for ready-made keychains, or reach out for a custom request.
You'll choose hardware color, then decide between a standard charm stack or a beaded sequence. Beaded designs will let you arrange letters, colors, and shapes — with live preview as you go.
Version 1 will use lightweight layered images so it stays fast on every device. No heavy 3D, no laggy canvas tricks.
Explore current keychains in the shop, or tell us about a fully custom idea through Custom Creations.
